title: Yakeen Payments Made Simple
tagline: Making Crypto Payments Simple and available For Adoption For A Greater Non Native India. It's time to revolutionize the way we transact.
description:
Many people in India are hesitant to adopt crypto payments due to perceived difficulties, costs involved, challenges and lack of awareness. It's time to address these concerns.  Yakeen offers a range of services, including lending and borrowing, creating opportunities for users to cover the costs of other operations in a secured safe way. By providing insurance services within the SuperApp, Yakeen enhances the security and peace of mind for our users. It Helps To Diversify and Balance Users Investments Which Not Only Includes TradFi Assets But Real World Assets Like Bonds and Debentures. We Also Provide Our Signature Way, Where we Fetch Prices From around 180 Liquidity Providers and Provide You The Best Prices During Payment. So Our Model Works With Predefined as well as User Accepted Slippages That In a Way Help Us Achive This Crucial Functionality. So If The 
```
| RealTime Fetched Price - Decided Price To Pay | > Slippage
```
We have Incorporated Aadhar and PAN as the first process for identity verification which is mandatory and safe move. It not only aligns with government regulations but also builds trust with users. Aadhar can help bridge the gap between the government and businesses, ensuring compliance and security in customer onboarding. (Planning To Upgrade To Full KYC And Higher Limits)

how_its_made:
Navigating the integration of Web3 libraries with React Native and managing different dependencies for both platforms
Ensuring consistent UI/UX across React Native and web platforms with limited time for thorough testing.
Efficiently testing and debugging code on both platforms, considering the differences in debugging tools and environments.
Addressing security challenges in smart contract interactions and handling sensitive user data on the frontend and backend.
